description_en: Queries the compliance evaluation report that is generated based on a compliance package of an account group
description_zh: 获取指定账号组内指定合规包的评估报告
kebab_example: aliyun config get-aggregate-compliance-pack-report --compliance-pack-id cp-fdc8626622af00f90000 --aggregator-id ca-f632626622af00790000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAggregateCompliancePackReport

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the compliance package.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a compliance package, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.help_zh:
合规包ID。

关于如何获取合规包ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.name: compliance_pack_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the account group.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of the account group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

CompliancePackReport.description_en: The compliance evaluation report that is generated based on a compliance package

AccountId.description_en: The ID of the management account to which the compliance package belongs
AccountId.description_zh: 合规包归属的企业管理账号ID

CompliancePackId.description_en: The ID of the compliance package

ReportCreateTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp when the compliance evaluation report was generated. Unit: milliseconds
ReportCreateTimestamp.description_zh: 创建合规包评估报告的时间戳。单位：毫秒

ReportStatus.description_en:
The status of the compliance evaluation report. Valid values:

NONE: The compliance evaluation report is not generated.
CREATING: The compliance evaluation report is being generated.
COMPLETE: The compliance evaluation report is generated
ReportStatus.description_zh:
合规包评估报告的状态。取值：
NONE：未创建。
CREATING：创建中。
COMPLETE：完成

ReportUrl.description_en: The URL that is used to download the compliance evaluation report
ReportUrl.description_zh: 合规包评估报告的下载地址
